questions.question: What is the maximum number of iterations configured for the autonomous agent loop?
questions.expected_answer: The maximum number of iterations configured for the autonomous agent loop is 15 steps.

questions.question: What are the default chunk size and chunk overlap parameters in MCPPRO?
questions.expected_answer: The default chunk size is 1000 characters with a chunk overlap of 200 characters.

questions.question: Which four vector store implementations are supported in MCPPRO?
questions.expected_answer: MCPPRO supports InMemoryVectorStoreService, QdrantVectorStoreService, SupabaseVectorStoreService, and PineconeVectorStoreService.

questions.question: What is the estimated RAM consumption of InMemoryVectorStore per 1,000 vectors with 1536 dimensions?
questions.expected_answer: InMemoryVectorStore consumes approximately 1.8MB of RAM per 1,000 vectors with 1536 dimensions.

questions.question: On which port does the RAG MCP server run by default?
questions.expected_answer: The RAG MCP server runs on port 8001 using streamable HTTP transport.

questions.question: What are the two tools exposed by the Python FastMCP server?
questions.expected_answer: The two tools exposed are 'retrieve_context' and 'rag_search'.

questions.question: Which two OCR engines are supported in MCPPRO?
questions.expected_answer: The dual OCR engine architecture supports PyTesseract and EasyOCR.

questions.question: How is the cache key derived in the VectorStoreCache module?
questions.expected_answer: The cache key is derived from the SHA-256 hash of the document URL combined with the loader variant suffix (std vs llm).

questions.question: Which HTTP status code is returned when an unauthorized request is made to /mcppro endpoints?
questions.expected_answer: Unauthorized requests immediately abort with HTTP 401 Unauthorized.

questions.question: List all 7 LLM providers supported by the LLMProviderFactory.
questions.expected_answer: The 7 supported providers are OpenAI, Google Gemini, Anthropic, Groq, Cerebras, OpenRouter, and LMStudio.

questions.question: What was the Q3 Actual Total Revenue reported in the financial summary?
questions.expected_answer: The Q3 Actual Total Revenue was $17.2M, representing a 38.7% YoY growth.

questions.question: What is the monthly hosting cost for LLM Inference APIs?
questions.expected_answer: The monthly hosting cost for LLM Inference APIs is $4250.00.

questions.question: Which prompt is used to format and clean the raw draft answer generated by WorkerMCPPro?
questions.expected_answer: The OutputParserPrompt is used to post-process and format the raw draft answer.

questions.question: How are telemetry writes executed to prevent slowing down API responses?
questions.expected_answer: All telemetry writes are scheduled as asynchronous BackgroundTasks in FastAPI.

questions.question: What technology is used for the client layer user interface?
questions.expected_answer: The client layer is implemented in Next.js 14 with React Server Components, Tailwind CSS, and Radix UI.

questions.question: How does MasterMCPPro decide whether to use Traditional RAG or Agentic Mode, and what happens if Traditional RAG fails?
questions.expected_answer: MasterMCPPro inspects the file extension, extracts a context snippet via initial preprocessing, and queries an LLM classifier. If Traditional RAG is selected and fails, MasterMCPPro automatically falls back to WorkerMCPPro agentic loop.

questions.question: Explain the full lifecycle of a document request when caching is enabled, distinguishing cold vs warm execution.
questions.expected_answer: On a cold request, the document is downloaded, parsed, chunked, embedded, indexed into the vector store, and serialized to disk in vector_store_cache/. On a warm request, the system computes the SHA-256 cache key, bypasses download/parsing/embedding, deserializes the pre-built index in under 25ms, and proceeds directly to query retrieval.

questions.question: How does CustomPptxLoader extract text from PowerPoint slides containing both text and images?
questions.expected_answer: CustomPptxLoader scans presentation shapes for picture objects, extracts image byte blobs into OpenCV matrices, runs OCR (PyTesseract or EasyOCR), and combines the OCR text with standard text extracted by BasePptxLoader.

questions.question: Describe the defense-in-depth measures implemented across the frontend orchestrator and backend API.
questions.expected_answer: The frontend uses refineQuery with gpt-4o-mini to sanitize prompts against script tags and injection, while the backend enforces Bearer Token authentication via verify_token and handles malformed inputs gracefully through FileProcessor.

questions.question: What happens inside the WorkerMCPPro execution loop when an invoked tool returns an error?
questions.expected_answer: The tool error message is captured into the execution log and appended to the conversation message list as a 'tool' role response, allowing the LLM to inspect the failure, adjust its strategy, or invoke alternative tools in subsequent iterations.

questions.question: Which infrastructure component had the second highest monthly cost, and who is its provider?
questions.expected_answer: Vector DB Hosting had the second highest monthly cost at $850.00, provided by Qdrant Cloud / Pinecone.

questions.question: What was the Gross Margin achieved in Q3 Actual compared to Q1 Actual?
questions.expected_answer: Gross Margin was 78.4% in Q3 Actual compared to 74.2% in Q1 Actual, an increase of 420 basis points.

questions.question: What distance metric and indexing algorithm are used by QdrantVectorStoreService?
questions.expected_answer: QdrantVectorStoreService uses Cosine distance metric with HNSW indexing.

questions.question: Which tool transport is used for Playwright browser automation in MCPPRO?
questions.expected_answer: Playwright automation uses the Stdio transport via @smithery/cli.

questions.question: List 4 attributes recorded in every telemetry log trace.
questions.expected_answer: Recorded attributes include request_id, document_url, processing_time, question_count, token_usage, and execution_log.

questions.question: Compare the embedding models described in the Architecture Overview with the Vector Store storage requirements in the Vector Database Specification.
questions.expected_answer: The Architecture Overview specifies 1536-dim (OpenAI text-embedding-3-small) and 1024-dim (BGE-M3) models, which correlate directly with the Vector Database specification where 1,000 vectors of 1536 dimensions require approximately 1.8MB of RAM in memory.

questions.question: How do the Python FastMCP server tools relate to the backend ToolRegistry in the Agentic Workflow?
questions.expected_answer: The FastMCP server exposes retrieve_context and rag_search over HTTP streamable transport, wrapping the underlying ToolRegistry and RetrievalService so remote orchestrators can invoke RAG as standard MCP tools.

questions.question: How does vector store caching reduce operational costs according to the financial infrastructure breakdown?
questions.expected_answer: Vector store caching avoids repeated LLM and embedding API calls on warm requests, directly controlling the LLM Inference API costs which represent the largest infrastructure expense at $4250/month.

questions.question: What specific threshold does ChunkCleaner use to discard uninformative text fragments?
questions.expected_answer: ChunkCleaner applies a minimum chunk length threshold of 100 characters.

questions.question: What is the exact model identifier configured for the LMStudio local inference provider?
questions.expected_answer: The configured LMStudio model identifier is 'qwen/qwen3-4b'.

questions.question: What is the target retrieval latency for Top-10 queries over Qdrant gRPC?
questions.expected_answer: The target Top-10 retrieval latency over Qdrant gRPC is under 45 milliseconds.
